text: Sanding and sawing are two of the most common woodworking tasks. Sanding starts by cutting the wood with a sharp knife, and then cleaning it with a dry sandpaper, which is a roller with a very fine mesh. Sawing works similarly, but instead of using a knife to cut the wood, the blade of the saw is used to cut the wood. The blade needs to be sharpened after each cut, and the wood needs to be dry when the saw cuts.
